title: App deploys fine but cannot reach its OData service
symptom:
The app renders but shows no data. The network tab reports 404 or 403 on /sap/opu/odata/...

It works locally (npm start) because the request goes through the ui5 middleware proxy.
rootCause:
Not verified. Common possibilities:
- the service is not published/activated on the tenant
- a Communication Arrangement is missing (for custom services on Public Cloud)
- the user lacks authorization for the service
- the `dataSource` uri in manifest.json points somewhere wrong

solutions.label: Call the service URL directly in the browser
solutions.body:
Take the uri from sap.app.dataSources in manifest.json, prepend the tenant host, and open it after signing in.

- 404 -> the service does not exist or is not activated
- 403 -> the service exists but the user lacks authorization
- 200 -> the problem is on the app side; check the manifest

solutions.label: Check the Communication Arrangement
solutions.body: Not verified for your specific case. On S/4HANA Public Cloud, exposing a service usually requires a matching Communication Scenario and Communication Arrangement. Check via the Communication Arrangements app.

solutions.label: Diff the deployed manifest against the repo
solutions.body: Open the manifest.json of the deployed app (through the app URL) and compare it with the one in the repository. Different uris mean the build used a mock configuration or a stale dist folder.

prevention: Keep the mock configuration (ui5-mock.yaml) clearly separate from the real one. Before handover, always test the app on the real tenant with an end-user account, not a developer account.
